description: Head-to-head record between two cricket teams from Cricsheet's Test/ODI/T20I/IPL match data: total matches, each team's wins, ties/no-results, and the most recent matches with their results. Pass team names as Cricsheet uses them, e.g. "India", "Australia", "Mumbai Indians" (IPL). Optionally scope to one format with `format`.

format.description: Match format: "Test", "ODI", "T20I" (international T20), or "IPL". Omit to search across every format this pack holds.

limit.description: Max recent matches to list, 1-100. Default 10.

offset.description: Pagination offset into the recent-matches list. Default 0.

name: cricsheet_head_to_head
title: Cricsheet Head To Head
